name: Drift
title: Void Balloonist
description: A daring aeronaut navigating the impossible winds of the Void in a balloon that shouldn't be able to fly.
greeting_variants: *adjusting rigging* Ho there! Didn't expect visitors at this altitude!
Drift, at your service! Navigator of nowhere!
*balloon creaking ominously* She flies on hope and hot air. Mostly hope.
The winds here... wrong direction. All directions. No directions.
*waving from basket* Come up! View's terrible! Fascinating, but terrible!
Ballooning in the Void. Madness? Yes. But what else to do?
*checking instruments, all spinning* Navigation... challenging. Exciting!
I map what cannot be mapped. Someone has to.

dialog_tree.text: Drift! Aeronaut extraordinaire! Or... was. Grounded by the Void, but not defeated! Built this beauty—*pats balloon* —from salvage. She flies on Void-winds. Unpredictable. Dangerous. But flying!

options.text: What do you see from up there?
Can you give me a ride?

dialog_tree.text: *grins* Magic! No, science! No... both? The Void has currents. Like air, but not. Like water, but not. My balloon catches them. Rides them. Sometimes where I want. Sometimes... elsewhere. Adventure!

party_reactions.drift: Theory keeps me alive! Barely! Worth it!

dialog_tree.text: *eyes gleam* Wonders! Horrors! The Void... it goes on. Forever? Layers. Like onion. Like cake. Like... geometry defying description. And the Palace—*points up* —always up there. Always distant. Always watching.

options.text: Tell me about the Palace from above.

dialog_tree.text: *excited* Passenger? YES! Weight is... concern. But courage! Come aboard! Hold tight! Scream if you need to! I certainly do!

mini_quest.title: Chart the Void Skies
mini_quest.description: Accompany Drift on an aerial survey to map the shifting geography of the Void from above.
objectives: Survey the First Layer from above

ambient_barks: Balloon holds! Patch 47 still holding! Good patch!
See that? *pointing* No? Gone now. Was amazing.
*singing while working* Oh I fly through the void so dark...
*shouting down* Hello ground! Still there? Hard to tell!

cross_zone_references.capital: Flew over once. Saw the camp. Small. Brave. Like ants. Noble ants.
cross_zone_references.chroma_tower: Tower pierces clouds! Even Void clouds! Impressive!
cross_zone_references.palace: Always above. Always distant. Goal! Destination! Mystery!

mira.greeting: Your aerial data would be invaluable!
mira.response: Data! Charts! Science! Yes! Come fly! Record!
